rows.label: GVM semantic completion
rows.replacement: Complete homes, live roots, tail/non-tail successors, denv/wind actions and allocation bounds in Scheme before C lowering
rows.retirement: Distributed semantic inference in C emission/macros; retain genuine target portability adapters
rows.benefit: Count semantic decisions once; lower invariant helper/parser bytes and stable ABI rebuild fanout
rows.addedCost: Contract descriptors, bootstrap and validation; no guaranteed code-size or time win
rows.premise: Producer/decoder/root map equivalence for every collecting successor; L2 and L4 maps differ

rows.label: ExecutionContext and GCParticipant
rows.replacement: Context owns Scheme registers/stack and stable identity; participant owns frozen/updateable root slots; VM owns heap epochs and membership
rows.retirement: PSTATE as inseparable carrier/execution/collector authority; TLS may cache an admitted context only
rows.benefit: A blocked native carrier need not hold up GC after its root cut; lightweight contexts can outnumber carriers
rows.addedCost: Publication/reload and context scheduling; affinity and opaque borrows limit migration
rows.premise: No unreported pointers or active borrow at freeze; no reentry before root reload and new grant

rows.label: Generational heap and independent collector work
rows.replacement: Context-local nursery with globally coordinated parallel STW minor; shared mature frames/objects; precise roots and remembered writes; major policy separate
rows.retirement: Full movable-heap copying as the only movable reclamation route; per-PSTATE work ownership; unchecked raw old-to-young stores
rows.benefit: Avoid m times the clean mature continuation graph scan; skip dead nursery data; expose load-balanced collection work
rows.addedCost: Barrier traffic, remembered scans, survivor promotion, nursery/reserve peak and synchronization; major cost remains
rows.premise: All frame/denv/FFI writers covered; overflow before store or conservative dirty fallback; promotion failure never loses source custody

rows.label: Repeatable continuation and dynamic control
rows.replacement: Captured logical frames remain reusable; each invocation obtains private execution materialization; shared Scheme heap and denv identities remain shared; run wind transitions in Scheme
rows.retirement: Separate frame interpretations across emit/capture/GC/restore/serialize; never consume a multi-shot continuation as one-shot
rows.benefit: Share eligible unchanged frame storage across shots; one frame schema enables profiler/debugger/GC/backend consumers
rows.addedCost: Per-shot restore/dispatch and semantic side effects remain; lazy restoration and COW require alias/reflection proofs
rows.premise: Multi-shot != parallel invocation guarantee; mutable frame APIs retain exact observable aliases; no C-stack resurrection

rows.label: Root-safe FFI and effect boundary
rows.replacement: Register roots before allocation; generated managed entry; blocking transfers root custody; nested callbacks create child activations; VM holds outcome and release tasks
rows.retirement: Per-wrapper ad hoc root/marker/unwind ownership and collector-side owner-callback waiting; old foreign ABI stays behind explicit adapters until coverage
rows.benefit: Remove repeated wrapper ownership logic; unblock GC while admitted calls wait; reusable effect/resource metadata
rows.addedCost: Stable handles, reloads, result slots, native lifetime budgets and affinity queues; unknown writers keep conservative/refusal path
rows.premise: Managed callback escape becomes explicit outcome before C unwinds; raw active C frames are not repeatable resources

rows.label: Scheduler and carrier independence
rows.replacement: Queue explicit context continuations with exclusive run grants; admitted parked contexts scanned independently; task identity/cancellation separated from continuation reuse
rows.retirement: OS-thread identity implicitly authorizing execution and retaining collector responsibility after exit
rows.benefit: M suspended computations can use P carriers with M greater than P; scheduling substrate can support libraries for effects without weakening call/cc
rows.addedCost: Queues, grants, wakeups and fairness; no automatic parallel map or effect replay; caller-visible task affinity preserved
rows.premise: No duplicate runnable owner; resource readiness does not grant Scheme execution; prove progress without GC/owner wait cycle

rows.label: Contract artifacts and backend services
rows.replacement: Build semantic plans separately from generated native units/runtime ABI; LLVM/MLIR are plan consumers and optimization services
rows.retirement: Repeated unaffected expansion/emission/compilation; duplicate semantic layouts; no requirement for a second Zig runtime
rows.benefit: Measure actions, generated and preprocessed bytes, invalidation fanout and critical path on Darwin
rows.addedCost: Dependency/snapshot storage and validation; runtime/ABI changes still invalidate their consumers
rows.premise: Clean/incremental observation equivalence; target contracts preserve all multishot successors before LLVM lowering
